name: onboarding
blurb: Multi-step onboarding flow with progress indicator, choice groups, and carousel.
description: Composable onboarding system with StepIndicator, ChoiceGroup, FeatureCarousel, TipsList, and Onboarding context. Supports both dots and pills progress variants, controlled and uncontrolled modes, and state callbacks for step navigation.
use_when: Building product walkthroughs, setup wizards, or feature tours that guide new users through sequential steps with visual feedback.
avoid_when: Simple single-screen flows. Not ideal when steps can be skipped or accessed non-sequentially.
a11y: Keyboard navigation for step transitions. Proper ARIA attributes on progress indicator. Role and live region support via composition.
